# Coloso

> > Coloso is a global online learning platform offering professional courses in illustration, character design, 3D animation, motion graphics, and culinary arts taught by industry experts.

Coloso provides comprehensive courses using industry-standard tools like Clip Studio Paint, Maya, Blender, Houdini, and After Effects. Courses are available in multiple languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Korean) and cover skill levels from beginner to advanced, with a focus on character illustration, animation workflows, and creative development.

## Key Topics

- Character Design
- Character Illustration
- 2D Animation
- Character Animation
- Clip Studio Paint
- Illustration Techniques
- Coloring Techniques
- Worldbuilding
- 3D Animation
- Motion Graphics
- Figure Drawing
- Concept Art
- Rendering Workflow
- IP Development
- Visual Storytelling

## Character Design & Illustration

- [Mastering Professional Depth and Clean Coloring Across Genres](https://coloso.global/products/illustrator-yanggae-us): YANGGAE's pro illustration course: coloring, rendering & lighting techniques
- [From Imitation to Creation: Mastering Original Character Illustrations](https://coloso.global/products/illustrator-kiri-us): kiri's original character illustration course: design to stylization
- [Designing Standout Characters with Dynamic Contrast & Bold Silhouettes](https://coloso.global/products/dictionary-2p-us): 2P's character design course: silhouettes, contrast & dynamic posing
- [Create Character Illustrations with Powerful Visual Impact](https://coloso.global/products/illustrator-kafun-zh): Kafun's character illustration course with Clip Studio Paint (Japanese)
- [Functional and Dynamic Mecha Illlustration](https://coloso.global/products/illustrator-kironfan-us): Kiron Fan's mecha illustration course: anatomy, structure & rendering
- [Multiple Character Narrative Illustration From Black & White to Color](https://coloso.global/products/illustrator-chairannn-zh): chairannn's narrative illustration: multi-character compositions & color
